# TildaZ v0.10.7

**A new toolchain under the hood, a benchmarks page, and macOS 15 as the new minimum.**

- TildaZ is now built with Zig 0.17. Output speed is unchanged; we measured it on Linux, macOS and Windows before switching. ([#820](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/820))
- New [benchmarks page](https://ensky0.github.io/tildaz/benchmarks/) compares TildaZ with other terminals on each platform. ([#810](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/810))
- macOS 15 or later is now required. ([#825](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/825))

## Upgrade notes

- macOS 14 is no longer supported. Stay on v0.10.6 if you need it. ([#825](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/825))
- Building from source now requires Zig 0.17.0. ([#820](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/820))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.10.7-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh --release`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.10.7-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.10.7-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.10.7-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.10.7-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 15+ universal | `tildaz-v0.10.7-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.10.7-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.10.7-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
